Question 17
?

If f(x)=sin⁡xarcoth⁡x, then f′(x)=cos⁡xarcoth⁡x+g(x). What is g(x)?

a
sin⁡x1+x2arcoth⁡x
b
cos⁡x(1−x2)arcoth2⁡x
c
 −cos2⁡x(1−x2)arcoth⁡x
d
−sin⁡x(1−x2)arcoth2⁡x
e
−sin2⁡x1+x2arcoth2⁡x
